negative_findings.description: No group-level press release or ad-hoc announcement dedicated specifically to a Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo CEO/management-board appointment was found in the searches run. RBI's 2025 board-reorganisation release is group-level only.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for RBI/Kosovo must lean on roster diffing of raiffeisen-kosovo.com rather than expecting a group release; a release-only strategy would miss appointments.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-yield parent-group disclosure languages for this cell are Slovene (NLB/SEOnet), German (ProCredit Holding, RBI ad-hoc) and Turkish (KAP, TEB, Ziraat) — none of which are in the declared sq/sr/en language set.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the run's language set to include sl, de and tr for workstream A5 cell 3, or accept a systematic lag behind local-language pickup.

coverage_gaps.description: Statutory portals (KAP for TEB/Turkish entities, SEOnet for NLB, and the German Bundesanzeiger/EQS pipeline for ProCredit Holding and RBI) were identified but not queried through their own interfaces within this scouting pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build issuer-scoped queries directly against KAP, SEOnet and EQS/Bundesanzeiger rather than relying on general web search indexing.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo's central bank (BQK/CBK) approves bank senior-management appointments, so its approvals/licensing register would corroborate or pre-date parent-group announcements; that regulator branch sits outside this cell and was not scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another coverage cell scouts BQK/CBK approval notices and cross-link them to the parent-group releases catalogued here.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is strong on leadership/structural signals but essentially empty on 'jobs/hiring' — parent groups do not advertise Kosovo-unit vacancies on group IR channels.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route hiring-volume signals to career-portal and job-board cells (group career sites, subsidiary career pages, LinkedIn jobs), and treat this cell as leadership/structure only.

coverage_gaps.description: Other foreign owners with Kosovo banking/payments exposure (e.g. the Albanian and Turkish owners of smaller Kosovo banks and non-bank financial institutions) were not enumerated within the six named actors of this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map from the Kosovo bank licence register to catch every foreign-parent entity, then repeat this cell's method for each.

brief: Foreign parent groups are the most legally reliable publishers of Kosovo-unit leadership and structural change, but they are unevenly generous: NLB (Ljubljana-listed, SEOnet + IR) and ProCredit Holding (Frankfurt-listed, dated press archive) genuinely name Kosovo people and units in their releases, while RBI, BKT/Çalık and Ziraat almost never do — for those, the only dependable primary record is the subsidiary's own board/senior-management roster page, monitored by diff. The statutory venues (SEOnet, KAP, EQS/Bundesanzeiger) are the highest-authority layer and are open, but they must be queried through their own interfaces rather than via general web search, which indexes them poorly. The practical language of this cell is Slovene, German and Turkish rather than the run's sq/sr/en, so an English- or Albanian-only watch will consistently see the Kosovo appointment days after the group has already disclosed it.
